name: gizza-ai/torrent-file-inspector
summary: Parse a .torrent file and show its name, files, trackers, and info-hash.

tool.description: Inspect a BitTorrent .torrent file: parse its bencoded metainfo and report the suggested name, the file list with each file's size, the total size, the tracker announce URLs (from announce and announce-list), the piece length and piece count, whether it is a private torrent, the BitTorrent v1 info-hash (SHA-1 of the bencoded info dictionary, the magnet-link btih), and the optional comment, created-by, and creation-date fields. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
